This page provides four recorded SimplePad cases from the independent data snapshot `data-2026.11.01-r1`.

::: {.callout-note title="Runtime verification"}
Original simulation results are preserved; rerunning or analyzing them in a new environment is still pending verification.
:::

## Cases

These cases use **200 nm aluminum**; the current PDK default is **100 nm**.

## Use the packages

- **Inputs** contain the original mesh and configuration for rerunning or profiling.
- **Results** contain the saved outputs for analysis.

Download each archive with `SHA256SUMS` from the [data release](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/releases/tag/data-2026.11.01-r1), then verify it before extraction:

```bash
sha256sum --ignore-missing -c SHA256SUMS
```

For Palace Eigenmode results, download both parts and follow the [Release instructions](https://github.com/NCUPHY-LTLab/orcapen-sc-pdk/releases/tag/data-2026.11.01-r1) to reassemble and verify the archive. Extract verified files into a fresh directory.
